description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter with a +1/+1 counter due to Arwen.
When Scurry Oak enters, it triggers, creating a creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to Arwen.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to Arwen.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.
